fields.name: unused
fields.meaning: Never written by the game; stays zero
fields.evidence: code: init 4000:0024 clears only from 0x20; diff: zero in all played saves

fields.name: magic
fields.meaning: Signature text "- OnePiece TW2 -"; if it does not match at power-on the whole save area is wiped and re-initialised
fields.evidence: code: compare 4000:0000, init 4000:0024; boot reads at 4000:0012

fields.name: header_check
fields.meaning: Check word for the shared header 0x0022-0x00BB: bitwise NOT of the 16-bit sum of those 154 bytes
fields.evidence: code: verify 4000:008e (SI=0x20,CX=0x9c) / write 4000:00bc; recomputed 385/385 blocks over every played save

fields.name: header_reserved
fields.meaning: Inside the checked header but never copied to or from memory; always zero
fields.evidence: code: header copies start at 0x32 (4000:00fa/4000:0144); diff all zero

fields.name: header_shuffle_table
fields.meaning: Shared table loaded into memory at power-on; holds a shuffled order of the 25 numbers 0-24 followed by zeros. Written once at first boot, never changes after. Probably the random layout of a 25-cell board
fields.evidence: code: copy 4000:00fa/4000:0144 to and from RAM 0x0AAA; diff: written at first boot, identical in all later saves

fields.name: header_progress
fields.meaning: Shared progress and record area (same memory is also stored inside each game slot). After a slot is loaded, bits 0x1FFE of its first word are taken from this header copy. Two bytes change when stage 1 events happen
fields.evidence: code: copy 4000:00fa/4000:0144 to and from RAM 0x0A12; merge 4000:0494; diff: bytes 0x58/0x60 go 00 to 02/01 mid-play; per-byte purpose unknown

fields.name: header_sys0
fields.meaning: System flag word. Fresh boot value 0x0016. During play it reads 0x0517 or 0x8517: low bits 0x16 persist, 0x0501 is set fresh at the story menu, 0x8000 means the save was checked this power-on and is cleared again after the menu. The menu also sets 0x4080 live when a game exists to continue, but that never appears in saved headers
fields.evidence: code: copy to and from RAM 0x2580 (4000:00fa/0144); fresh values set at 6000:033c; menu bits set at 6000:245a/2480; 0x8000 set at 6000:09be and cleared at 6000:4120; diff: 0016 then 8517 then 0517 frozen

fields.name: header_sys1
fields.meaning: Second system word, always 0xC000 once the save exists (set at first boot). The code can set a one-time bit 0x40 here, but that bit never appears in any played save
fields.evidence: code: copy to and from RAM 0x2582; fresh value set at 6000:033c; 0x40 set at 6000:0a19; diff: constant C000

fields.name: header_sys_spare
fields.meaning: Rest of the system block; zero in every played save
fields.evidence: code: copied with the system block (4000:00fa/0144); diff all zero

fields.name: slotA0.check
fields.meaning: Slot A0 is the frozen copy from the moment the stage started (written once, never again). Check word: bitwise NOT of the 16-bit sum of the next 0xABD bytes
fields.evidence: code: 4000:00bc (CX=0xABF) write, 4000:008e verify before load in 4000:0238; recomputed over every played save

fields.name: slotA0.in_use
fields.meaning: 1 means the slot holds a game, 0 means empty
fields.evidence: code: write 4000:0224, test 4000:02f8; boot reads at 4000:030e; verified: game offers CONTINUE when set

fields.name: slotA0.game_mode
fields.meaning: Which game mode the slot belongs to; 0 in every played save (story mode, slot type A)
fields.evidence: code: RAM 0x0DB0 set at 5000:006b; type picked at 5000:2f77; diff always 0

fields.name: slotA0.resume_setting
fields.meaning: Two stale bytes (0x53, 0x39): this slot is saved without refreshing them, so they show older values of a sound-setting byte. The live value is 0x39 in every in-play save
fields.evidence: code: 5000:2f6b refreshes these bytes only for slot 1; diff: frozen 53/39 here vs 39/39 in the in-play slot

fields.name: slotA0.session_misc
fields.meaning: Stage-start values of the 13 session bytes (counters and flags described under the in-play slot); frozen. Includes the constant word 0x4000 at session+0x08 (file 0xC8)
fields.evidence: code: block copy of RAM 0x0DB3-0x0DBF; diff frozen

fields.name: slotA0.session_flags
fields.meaning: Session flag word, 0x1701 here as in every saved game: high byte echoes the system flags, low bit set by the load routine. Bit 0x0400 allows saving, 0x4000 picks the stage-start slot at load, 0x0080 marks a resumed game
fields.evidence: code: computed at 5000:2e8e from RAM 0x2580 (exact value match), tested at 5000:2f44/2fa1/2fab; diff constant 1701

fields.name: slotA0.session_misc2
fields.meaning: Stage-start values of 10 more session bytes; first byte copies bits 8-9 of the system flags (0x01), rest are the constants 01 07 07 07 07 00 00 00 00
fields.evidence: code: first byte set at 5000:2e8e (exact match); diff constant

fields.name: slotA0.resume_state
fields.meaning: Game-flow step to resume at (current, previous): 0002/0001, the stage-start steps
fields.evidence: code: 5000:2f56 copies live steps RAM 0x07D7/0x07D9 (previous step saved then advanced 1 to 2); diff constant

fields.name: slotA0.session_tail
fields.meaning: Last session bytes, 00 00 00 00 01 01; first four are cleared by the pre-load routine
fields.evidence: code: cleared at 5000:2ff0; diff constant

fields.name: slotA0.characters
fields.meaning: 7 character records of 0xF3 bytes (layout as in the in-play slot). At stage start the first four are fresh and full, the fifth is empty and joins later, the last two stay empty
fields.evidence: code: block copy of RAM 0x0DD6; diff vs in-play slot; screenshot ties HP/TP bytes to the status panel

fields.name: slotA0.board_state
fields.meaning: Stage-start values of the board block (layout as in the in-play slot): turn counter 0, empty event state, unused-table entries not yet marked
fields.evidence: code: block copy of RAM 0x147B; diff frozen

fields.name: slotA0.progress_copy
fields.meaning: Copy of the shared progress area as it was when the stage started (still all zero); the header copy moves on
fields.evidence: code: block copy of RAM 0x0A12; diff: frozen zeros while header bytes change

fields.name: slotA0.area_a72
fields.meaning: Memory 0x0A72-0x0A81; zero in every played save
fields.evidence: code: block copy exists; diff all zero

fields.name: slotA0.area_a82
fields.meaning: Memory 0x0A82-0x0AA9; zero in every played save
fields.evidence: code: block copy exists; diff all zero

fields.name: slotA0.map_layer_1
fields.meaning: First board map table; all zero in every played save (unused in story mode)
fields.evidence: code: block copy of RAM 0x1593; diff all zero

fields.name: slotA0.map_layer_2
fields.meaning: Second board map table: the filled static stage map, already present in the stage-start snapshot (s34 A0 byte-identical to every in-play A1 map, sha 00beadf545c9, 209 nonzero bytes)
fields.evidence: code: block copy of RAM 0x1693; diff: s34-A0 == s71-A1

fields.name: slotA0.event_flags
fields.meaning: Stage event bits; none set yet at stage start
fields.evidence: code: block copy of RAM 0x285D; diff empty here, bits appear mid-play

fields.name: slotA0.event_log
fields.meaning: Room for 40 4-byte event records; empty at stage start
fields.evidence: code: block copy of RAM 0x28C9; diff empty here, records append mid-play

fields.name: slotA1.check
fields.meaning: Slot A1 is the live in-play save (rewritten during play; this is what CONTINUE loads). Check word: bitwise NOT of the 16-bit sum of the next 0xABD bytes
fields.evidence: code: 4000:00bc (CX=0xABF) write, 4000:008e verify before load in 4000:0238; recomputed over every played save

fields.name: slotA1.in_use
fields.meaning: 1 means the slot holds a game (offers CONTINUE), 0 means empty
fields.evidence: code: write 4000:0224, test 4000:02f8; checked with slot 1 at 6000:2479; verified by loading

fields.name: slotA1.game_mode
fields.meaning: Which game mode the slot belongs to; 0 in every played save (story mode, slot type A)
fields.evidence: code: RAM 0x0DB0 set at 5000:006b; type picked at 5000:2f77; diff always 0

fields.name: slotA1.resume_setting
fields.meaning: Copy of a sound-setting byte (0x39 in every in-play save), refreshed from live memory at each save
fields.evidence: code: 5000:2f6b copies RAM 0x0113 for slot 1 only; RAM 0x0113 stored at 4000:11ee just before a sound-bank call, boot value 0x20; diff constant 39/39

fields.name: slotA1.turn_flow
fields.meaning: Turn or menu flow state: 00 at the first in-play save, 01 through mid-play, FF later. The forced save command only runs when this is 00
fields.evidence: code: gates the forced save at 5000:0ecb, alternate path at 5000:0f17, read at 5000:0b65; diff 00 then 01 then FF

fields.name: slotA1.session_reserved3
fields.meaning: Three session bytes, always zero
fields.evidence: code: block copy of RAM 0x0DB4-0x0DB6; diff all zero

fields.name: slotA1.round_counter
fields.meaning: Round counter rising by 2 per save (00 02 02 04 04 06 06), tracking the board turn counter
fields.evidence: code: block copy of RAM 0x0DB7; diff lockstep with board turn byte

fields.name: slotA1.db8_word
fields.meaning: Constant word 0x4000 (bytes 00 40) whenever the slot is in use, 0000 when empty. db8 is cleared at game init; db9=0x40 writer unknown. Not the session flags (those are at 0x0B8F)
fields.evidence: code: block copy of RAM 0x0DB8-0x0DB9, cleared at 5000:009e; diff: 0040 in all 45 in-use A1 images

fields.name: slotA1.event_counter_a
fields.meaning: Small counter with a flag in bit 7: raised step by step to 5 between saves, used to look up display and sound data
fields.evidence: code: raised and masked at 5000:7590, flag cleared at 5000:757d, feeds a table call at 4000:148c; live write trace; diff 00 then 05

fields.name: slotA1.event_counter_b
fields.meaning: Second small counter, raised to 4 the same way
fields.evidence: code: raised at 5000:75d6, compared to 4 at 5000:75cf, feeds the same table call; live write trace; diff 00 then 04

fields.name: slotA1.session_reserved1
fields.meaning: Three session bytes, always zero
fields.evidence: code: block copy of RAM 0x0DBC-0x0DBE; diff all zero

fields.name: slotA1.session_flag_byte
fields.meaning: One session flag byte: FF through mid-play, 01 later
fields.evidence: code: block copy of RAM 0x0DBF; diff FF then 01; exact purpose unknown

fields.name: slotA1.session_flags
fields.meaning: Session flag word, 0x1701 in every saved game: high byte echoes the system flags, low bit set by the load routine. Bit 0x0400 allows saving, 0x4000 picks the stage-start slot at load, 0x0080 marks a resumed game
fields.evidence: code: computed at 5000:2e8e from RAM 0x2580 (exact value match), tested at 5000:2f44/2fa1/2fab, set at 5000:2fe6; diff constant 1701

fields.name: slotA1.sysbits_copy
fields.meaning: Bits 8-9 of the system flags (0x01), copied at load time
fields.evidence: code: set at 5000:2e8e from RAM 0x2580 (exact match with saved 0x0517); diff constant 01

fields.name: slotA1.session_dc3_const7
fields.meaning: First byte is the sysbits copy dc3 (bits 10-11 of the system flags = 0x01, set by 5000:2e8e); the other seven bytes are the constants 07 07 07 07 00 00 00
fields.evidence: code: dc3 set at 5000:2e8e (exact match with saved 0x0517) + block copy of RAM 0x0DC3-0x0DCA; diff constant; trailing purpose unknown

fields.name: slotA1.phase_flag
fields.meaning: Turn-phase flag alternating 07/00 between saves; board bytes change in step with it
fields.evidence: code: block copy of RAM 0x0DCB; diff alternates exactly with the board phase bytes

fields.name: slotA1.resume_state
fields.meaning: Game-flow step to resume at on CONTINUE (current, previous): 001F/001E in every in-play save
fields.evidence: code: 5000:2f56 copies live steps RAM 0x07D7/0x07D9; game sets step 0x1F just before the mid-play save at 5000:099e; diff constant

fields.name: slotA1.session_tail
fields.meaning: Last session bytes, 00 00 00 00 01 01; the first four are cleared by the pre-load routine
fields.evidence: code: cleared at 5000:2ff0; diff constant

fields.name: slotA1.characters
fields.meaning: 7 character records of 0xF3 bytes (party members and board characters). Per record: +0 id, +4/+5 base HP/TP, +6 current HP (falls in fights), +8/+9 max HP/TP, +0x0E board position, +0x10 controller (01 human, FF computer, 00 unused), +0x11 record number; small per-character stats at +1/+3/+0x0A/+0x0B/+0x0F; the rest is per-character board and item data
fields.evidence: code: block copy of RAM 0x0DD6; diff: three records wounded across mid-play saves, fifth record filled when it joins; screenshot: panel shows record 0 as HP 15/15 TP 8/8

fields.name: slotA1.turn_number
fields.meaning: Turn counter 00 to 03 across mid-play saves; read right after a CONTINUE load
fields.evidence: code: block copy of RAM 0x147B; read at 5000:03f4 after loading; diff rises with the round counter

fields.name: slotA1.board_reserved
fields.meaning: One board byte, always zero in saves (compared live by code at 5000:3111/040b/5073, so it can be nonzero between saves)
fields.evidence: code: block copy of RAM 0x147C; diff zero in saves

fields.name: slotA1.phase_words_a
fields.meaning: Two alternating words tied to the turn phase (9800/3001 vs 480x/xxxx)
fields.evidence: code: block copy of RAM 0x147D-0x1480; diff alternates with the phase flag

fields.name: slotA1.phase_byte
fields.meaning: Board phase byte: 00, 04, or 10
fields.evidence: code: block copy of RAM 0x1481; bits set and cleared by board routines (5000:0eb6/0b40/03b6/0405); diff follows the phase

fields.name: slotA1.board_const4
fields.meaning: Four constant board bytes (00 00 00 00 then FF marker follows)
fields.evidence: code: block copy of RAM 0x1482-0x1485; diff constant; writers zero them at 5000:129e

fields.name: slotA1.board_const9
fields.meaning: Nine constant board bytes (FF 81 81 42 36 24 38 A8 34)
fields.evidence: code: block copy of RAM 0x1486-0x148E; diff constant; purpose unknown

fields.name: slotA1.round_allotment
fields.meaning: Three lockstep 16-bit counters (two here, one at 0x1272): 00F3, then 01E6, 02D9, reset to 0
fields.evidence: code: block copy of RAM 0x148F/1491/149D; diff moves in lockstep with the turn counter; purpose unknown

fields.name: slotA1.board_ff14
fields.meaning: 14 bytes of FF padding
fields.evidence: code: block copy; diff constant FF

fields.name: slotA1.round_allotment_c
fields.meaning: Third word of the lockstep counters above
fields.evidence: code: block copy of RAM 0x149D; diff lockstep

fields.name: slotA1.board_zero3
fields.meaning: Three zero bytes
fields.evidence: code: block copy; diff zero

fields.name: slotA1.phase_flag_b
fields.meaning: Second phase flag byte: 00 or FF, matching the turn phase
fields.evidence: code: block copy of RAM 0x14A2; diff matches the phase flag exactly

fields.name: slotA1.board_zero4
fields.meaning: Four zero bytes
fields.evidence: code: block copy; diff zero

fields.name: slotA1.board_const0f
fields.meaning: Constant byte 0x0F
fields.evidence: code: block copy; diff constant; purpose unknown

fields.name: slotA1.board_zero21
fields.meaning: 21 zero bytes
fields.evidence: code: block copy; diff zero

fields.name: slotA1.progress_marks
fields.meaning: Five 2-byte progress counters (index + count) that move at every save, even saves that change nothing else; they advance against a data table and reset near zero when a new round starts
fields.evidence: code: block copy of RAM 0x14C3; advanced at 5000:47ca/47e5/4816 against the table at 0x1461; live write trace; diff changes at every save but matches no screen value

fields.name: slotA1.board_zero10
fields.meaning: 10 zero bytes
fields.evidence: code: block copy; diff zero

fields.name: slotA1.table_count
fields.meaning: Single byte 0x0D heading the table below; constant
fields.evidence: code: block copy; diff constant; purpose unknown

fields.name: slotA1.used_table
fields.meaning: 16-entry shuffle of the numbers 0-15; entries gain bit 0x80 one group at a time as they are consumed (5 of 16 by late saves)
fields.evidence: code: block copy of RAM 0x14D8-0x14E7; diff: permutation fixed, 0x80 bits accumulate monotonically

fields.name: slotA1.board_zero1
fields.meaning: One zero byte
fields.evidence: code: block copy; diff zero

fields.name: slotA1.phase_pair
fields.meaning: Phase pair: 0000 normally, 0602 or 0902 exactly when the phase flag is set
fields.evidence: code: block copy of RAM 0x14E9-0x14EA; diff matches the phase flag

fields.name: slotA1.board_zero16
fields.meaning: 16 zero bytes
fields.evidence: code: block copy; diff zero

fields.name: slotA1.board_zero2
fields.meaning: Two zero bytes
fields.evidence: code: block copy; diff zero

fields.name: slotA1.phase_flag_c
fields.meaning: Third phase flag byte: 00 or 02, matching the turn phase
fields.evidence: code: block copy of RAM 0x14FD; diff matches the phase flag exactly

fields.name: slotA1.board_zero1b
fields.meaning: One zero byte
fields.evidence: code: block copy; diff zero

fields.name: slotA1.round_counts
fields.meaning: Four per-round count bytes, rewritten most saves
fields.evidence: code: block copy of RAM 0x14FF-0x1502; diff varies; exact events counted unknown

fields.name: slotA1.board_zero4b
fields.meaning: Four zero bytes
fields.evidence: code: block copy; diff zero

fields.name: slotA1.countdown8
fields.meaning: Constant countdown 07 06 05 04 03 02 01 00
fields.evidence: code: block copy; diff constant; purpose unknown

fields.name: slotA1.board_const85
fields.meaning: Constant byte 0x85
fields.evidence: code: block copy; diff constant; purpose unknown

fields.name: slotA1.board_zero3b
fields.meaning: Three zero bytes
fields.evidence: code: block copy; diff zero

fields.name: slotA1.progress_copy
fields.meaning: Copy of the shared progress area, always identical to the header copy in this slot
fields.evidence: code: block copy of RAM 0x0A12; diff equals header in every save

fields.name: slotA1.area_a72
fields.meaning: Memory 0x0A72-0x0A81; zero in every played save
fields.evidence: code: block copy exists; diff all zero

fields.name: slotA1.area_a82
fields.meaning: Memory 0x0A82-0x0AA9; zero in every played save
fields.evidence: code: block copy exists; diff all zero

fields.name: slotA1.map_layer_1
fields.meaning: First board map table; all zero in every played save (unused in story mode)
fields.evidence: code: block copy of RAM 0x1593; diff all zero

fields.name: slotA1.map_layer_2
fields.meaning: Second board map table: a fixed stage map, filled by stage start (already in the s34 A0 snapshot) and never changed after; byte-identical in all 45 in-use A1 images
fields.evidence: code: block copy of RAM 0x1693; diff: single sha 00beadf545c9 over every in-use slot

fields.name: slotA1.event_flags
fields.meaning: Stage event bits, only ever set, never cleared
fields.evidence: code: block copy of RAM 0x285D; diff grows monotonically; per-bit events unknown

fields.name: slotA1.event_log
fields.meaning: Up to 40 event records of 4 bytes, appended during play (none at stage start, 10 by late saves, then stops). Kind 04 opens the log, kind 01 carries two parameter bytes, kind 03 is a plain marker
fields.evidence: code: block copy of RAM 0x28C9; diff append-only; per-kind meaning unknown

fields.name: slotB0
fields.meaning: Second slot type, used when the game mode byte is 1: check word (NOT of sum of next 0xA87 bytes), in-use word, a copy of the system word, then the same memory as slot A minus the 0x0A72 and 0x0A82 pieces. Empty in every played save
fields.evidence: code: writer 4000:031a, loader 4000:03bc, in-use test 4000:0472 (unreferenced), init 4000:0024; diff empty

fields.name: slotB1
fields.meaning: Second slot of type B, same layout as slot B0. Empty in every played save
fields.evidence: code: same routines with index 1; diff empty

fields.name: unused
fields.meaning: Never written; zero
fields.evidence: code: init clears 0x20-0x2B4B only; diff zero

fields.name: unused
fields.meaning: Not used by this game: 22 nonzero bytes near 0x60 are identical in every played save (console defaults), the game never writes here
fields.evidence: diff: byte-identical across all saves incl. fresh extra saves; no writer in the save callers
